description: Five formant filters that shape any signal into a sung vowel

params.text: Picks the first vowel, from A, E, I, O and U
Picks the second vowel, from A, E, I, O and U
Crossfades the formant settings between the two chosen vowels, 0 to 100%
Picks the voice the formant frequencies are taken from: bass, tenor, counter-tenor, alto or soprano
Multiplies every formant frequency together, from 0 to twice its value, the chosen voice's own frequencies being 100%
Shifts that formant's frequency by as much as 50% either way from the vowel's own value
Sets that formant's level, 0 to 200%, the vowel's own level being 100%
Sets how far the VOWEL 1 input moves the first vowel, and in which direction
Sets how far the VOWEL 2 input moves the second vowel, and in which direction
Sets how far the BALANCE input moves the crossfade between the two vowels, and in which direction
Sets how far the VOCAL RANGE input moves the chosen voice, and in which direction
Sets how far the Fc input moves every formant frequency, and in which direction
Sets how far that formant's frequency input shifts it, and in which direction
Sets how far that formant's amplitude input moves its level, and in which direction

inputs.text: The signal the five formant filters are applied to
Voltage that picks the first vowel, by the amount its attenuverter sets
Voltage that picks the second vowel, by the amount its attenuverter sets
Voltage that moves the crossfade between the two vowels, by the amount its attenuverter sets
Voltage that picks the voice, by the amount its attenuverter sets
Voltage that moves every formant frequency together, by the amount its attenuverter sets
Voltage that shifts that formant's frequency, by the amount its attenuverter sets
Voltage that moves that formant's level, by the amount its attenuverter sets
